tools.name: status
tools.title: Revit status
tools.description: Start here. Lists running Revit versions and open docs (#1, #2...), the pinned target doc, active view, selection count, levels and busy/dialog state. include= adds sections; detail=full adds health.

include.description: Extra sections for the target doc (writes = recent writes by any session).

detail.description: full adds versions, paths, queue and pipe health.

instance.description: Only this Revit: year (2024) or process id.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: set_target
tools.title: Pin target document
tools.description: Pin the doc that every call uses this session: 'active', a # from status, a title or a path. 'follow' tracks the active tab; 'none' unpins. Family docs work too; links are read with find_elements link=.

doc.description: 'active', 'follow', 'none', #, title or path.

instance.description: Revit year or process id when the same file is open twice.

tools.name: list
tools.title: List model items
tools.description: List items of one kind (levels, views, sheets, schedules, rooms, types, families, materials, worksets, phases, links, revisions, filters, templates...) as compact rows. name= filters; for_element= valid types.

level.description: Level name or id (rooms, areas, spaces, views).

view_type.description: For views/view_types: FloorPlan, CeilingPlan, Section, Elevation, ThreeD, Drafting, Legend, AreaPlan, Sheet...

for_element.description: For types: element id; returns only types it can switch to.

placed.description: Views: on a sheet or not. Rooms/areas: placed or not.

graphical.description: Views: only graphical views (no schedules or browser-only views).

printable.description: Views: only views that can be printed or exported.

class.description: Types: Revit API class, e.g. WallType, FloorType, FamilySymbol.

fields.description: Extra columns: location, bbox, host, room, workset, phase, or any parameter name.

page.description: Page token from a 'more:' line, e.g. p2.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: find_elements
tools.title: Find elements
tools.description: Find elements by category, level, type, view, selection, parameter values, box or link. Returns the exact total, compact rows and a handle r# for from= in later calls. count_only/group_by for fast counts.

class.description: Revit API class, e.g. Wall, FamilyInstance, Floor.

level.description: Level names or ids (a string is fine).

type.description: Type name, 'Family: Type' or id; * wildcard.

view.description: Only elements visible in this view ('active' ok).

from.description: Restrict to 'selection' or an r# handle.

where.description: Conditions 'Param op value', op: = != > >= < <= contains startswith empty notempty. Lengths mm.

link.description: Search inside this linked model (name or id); read-only, host coordinates.

hidden.description: With view=: include elements hidden in the view.

types.description: Find element types instead of instances.

fields.description: Extra columns: location, bbox, host, room, workset, phase, or any parameter name.

group_by.description: Count per category, type, family, level, workset or a parameter name.

page.description: Page token from a 'more:' line, e.g. p2.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: describe_elements
tools.title: Describe elements
tools.description: Details for up to 50 elements: parameters with values, units and writability, type parameters, geometry, host/hosted, room, joins, group, MEP connectors; dimensions show witness refs. Use before set_parameters.

from.description: Element set: r# handle from find_elements, 'selection', or 'last' (your last write).

params.description: Instance parameters: writable (default) values, all values, names only, none.

match.description: Only parameters whose name contains this.

link.description: Elements are inside this linked model.

page.description: Page token from a 'more:' line, e.g. p2.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: get_view
tools.title: Get view details
tools.description: One view or sheet: type, scale, detail level, template, crop, view range, phase, discipline; include= overrides, filters, hidden categories, viewports, revisions. Default: the active view.

view.description: View name, id, sheet number, or 'active' (default).

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: read_schedule
tools.title: Read schedule
tools.description: Read a schedule as a table (paged) with its fields, filters and sorting. category= without schedule= lists the fields available for a new schedule of that category.

category.description: Category for available fields before edit_schedules create.

available.description: Include fields that could be added. Default false.

key.description: Field unique per row that maps rows to element ids. Default Mark; no id column if not unique.

page.description: Page token from a 'more:' line, e.g. p2.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: read_family
tools.title: Read family
tools.description: Family parameters (name, type/instance, group, data type, formula, shared), family types with per-type values, category and nested families. family= loaded family, path= an .rfa file, or doc= an open family doc.

family.description: Loaded family name or id (read without opening the UI).

path.description: Path to an .rfa file (opened hidden, read-only).

types.description: Only these family types' values. Default all (up to 30).

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: check_model
tools.title: Check model
tools.description: Model health: stats (counts by category/level), warnings (grouped, element ids), readiness for common tasks, purgeable (unused items), clashes (set a vs b, links ok). Default check=stats.

a.description: Clashes: categories or an r# handle.

b.description: Clashes: categories or an r# handle. Default = a.

link.description: Clashes: set b is inside this linked model.

tolerance.description: Clashes: ignore overlaps smaller than this, mm. Default 0.

scenarios.description: Readiness: walls, floors, rooms, families, sheets, tags... Default common set.

page.description: Page token from a 'more:' line, e.g. p2.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: get_quantities
tools.title: Get quantities
tools.description: Quantity takeoff: count, length (m), area (m2), volume (m3) summed by material, type, level, category or family, for all or filtered elements. Default by=material.

view.description: Only elements visible in this view.

from.description: Element set: r# handle from find_elements, 'selection', or 'last' (your last write).

page.description: Page token from a 'more:' line, e.g. p2.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.title: Get changes
tools.description: What changed since a point: added, modified and deleted elements (id, category) and transaction names, by you or the user. since='session' (default), 'last' (your last write) or a mark m#.

since.description: 'session', 'last', or a mark like m12 from an earlier result.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: read_many
tools.title: Run several reads
tools.description: Run up to 8 read calls in one round trip, sharing one time budget (max 2 images): calls=[{tool:'list',args:{kind:'levels'}},{tool:'capture',args:{}}]. One failure does not stop the rest.

calls.description: Up to 8 {tool, args}; args as for that tool.

tools.name: capture
tools.title: Capture image
tools.description: See the model: returns an image of a view or sheet, or of elements (ids/from) in a temporary 3D box. region= zooms; size small|medium|large; compare= c# shows what changed. Nothing is kept in the model.

view.description: View name, id, sheet number, or 'active' (default).

ids.description: Focus these elements: temp 3D view boxed around them.

from.description: Focus an element set: r# handle, 'selection' or 'last'.

region.description: Zoom to [x0,y0,x1,y1] mm (model coords; sheet mm on sheets).

size.description: Long edge at most 768, 1280 or 1568 px. Default medium.

margin.description: Space around focused elements, mm. Default 1000.

highlight.description: Tint these element ids red in the image.

annotations.description: Show annotations. Default true for views, false for focus.

compare.description: Earlier capture id (c#): marks changed pixels.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: ui
tools.title: Control Revit UI
tools.description: Drive the Revit window without changing the model: select, zoom_to, temporary isolate/hide, reset, activate_view, activate_doc, list/close open views, list dialogs and press a dialog button.

op.description: sel = ids, from or filter. Params per op, optional after ';': select(sel;mode,zoom) zoom_to(ids/from/region/fit;view) isolate(ids/from/category;view) hide(ids/from/category;view) reset(;view) activate_view(view) activate_doc(doc) open_views() close_views(views) dialogs(;instance) press(button;dialog,instance,confirm)

from.description: Element set: r# handle from find_elements, 'selection', or 'last' (your last write).

view.description: View name, id, sheet number, or 'active'.

fit.description: zoom_to: zoom to fit the whole view.

zoom.description: select: also zoom to the selection.

dialog.description: Dialog id from op=dialogs. Default: the open one.

button.description: Button text or id. Cancel/Close apply at once; other buttons need the user's OK (confirm).

instance.description: dialogs/press: Revit year or process id. Default: every Revit.

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: create_elements
tools.title: Create elements
tools.description: Create levels, grids, walls, floors, roofs, ceilings, rooms, areas, separators, openings, shafts, ref planes, model lines, stairs, railings, curtain grids, toposolids. mm; applies now, returns ids and undo.

top.description: Top level (wall top constraint, shaft, stairs).

plans.description: level: also create floor and ceiling plans. Default true.

count.description: level/grid: how many to create. Default 1.

spacing.description: level/grid: distance between copies mm; curtain_grid: grid spacing.

through.description: Point on the arc: makes an arc (single segment).

points.description: [[x,y],...] mm: wall path, outline, stair path; toposolid [x,y,z] (z above level if set, else absolute).

profile.description: roof_extrusion: profile [[s,z],...] mm; s along start->end, z above level.

closed.description: Close the loop back to the first point.

type.description: Type: 'Family: Type', type name, or id.

height.description: wall: unconnected height mm when no top (default 3000); opening: opening height mm.

offset.description: Height above level mm (wall opening: sill height). Default 0.

slope_edges.description: roof: edge indexes that slope. Default all when slope set.

depth.description: roof_extrusion: extrusion length mm (left of start->end).

all.description: room: place rooms in every enclosed area of the level.

host.description: Host id: wall/floor/roof/ceiling (opening), stairs (railing), curtain wall (curtain_grid).

risers.description: stairs: riser count. Default from height.

direction.description: curtain_grid: direction of the new grid lines.

positions.description: curtain_grid: offsets mm from the wall start (vertical) or base (horizontal).

survey.description: toposolid: extra [[x,y,z]] points inside the outline.

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.

points.description: Several insertion points [[x,y(,z)],...]: one instance each.

tools.title: MEP systems
tools.description: MEP: pipes, ducts, conduits, cable trays and flex runs along points with automatic elbows; connect elements; create/edit piping, duct and electrical systems, circuits; insulation; spaces and zones.

op.description: Params per op, optional after ';': pipe(points,level;type,system,size,offset,slope,fittings) duct(points,level;type,system,size/width+height,offset,fittings) conduit(points,level;type,size,offset,fittings) cable_tray(points,level;type,width,height,offset,fittings) flex_pipe(points,level;type,system,size,offset) flex_duct(points,level;type,system,size,offset) connect(ids) system_create(ids,kind;name,type) system_add(system,ids) system_remove(system,ids) circuit(ids;panel) insulate(ids/from,type,thickness) space(level,at/all;name,number) zone(name,ids;level)

offset.description: Run centerline height above level mm. Default 2700.

system.description: System type (e.g. Domestic Cold Water, Supply Air) or system name.

fittings.description: Add elbows/tees at bends. Default true.

from.description: Element set: r# handle from find_elements, 'selection', or 'last' (your last write).

all.description: space: in every enclosed area of the level.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

preview.description: true = dry run: returns the plan and a confirm token, changes nothing.

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.

units.description: Unit of input lengths. Default mm.

tools.name: structure
tools.title: Structural elements
tools.description: Structure: columns at points or grid intersections, beams along lines or between columns, braces, beam systems, isolated/wall/slab foundations. type='Family: Type'; lengths mm.

op.description: Params per op, optional after ';': column(type,level,at/points/grids;top,offset,top_offset,rotation,start,end) beam(type,level,start+end/points/between;offset) brace(type,level,start,end) beam_system(type,level,points;spacing,direction) foundation(kind,type;ids/from,points,level)

type.description: Type: 'Family: Type', type name, or id.

top.description: column: top level. Default next level up.

points.description: Several points (columns) or a chain (beams, beam_system outline).

grids.description: column: at intersections of these grids; ['*'] = all.

between.description: beam: column ids to connect in order.

offset.description: Offset from level mm (beam z, column base).

direction.description: beam_system: beam direction degrees. Default 0 (x axis).

from.description: Element set: r# handle from find_elements, 'selection', or 'last' (your last write).

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

preview.description: true = dry run: returns the plan and a confirm token, changes nothing.

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.

units.description: Unit of input lengths. Default mm.

tools.name: manage_document
tools.title: Manage documents
tools.description: Files: open (rvt/rfa; detach, audit, worksets), activate, save, save_as, close, new project from template, new family from .rft, purge unused, project units, base/survey point. Risky ones ask to confirm.

op.description: Params per op, optional after ';': open(path;activate,detach,audit,worksets,local,central) activate(doc) save(;compact) save_as(path;overwrite,as_central,compact) close(doc;save) new_project(path;template,overwrite,activate) new_family(template,path) purge(;passes) set_units(unit;accuracy) coordinates(base_point/survey_point/true_north)

template.description: Template .rte/.rft path or name. new_project default: settings template.

activate.description: open/new_project: show it in the UI. Default true.

local.description: open (central model): path of the new local copy. Default Documents\<name>_<user>.rvt.

central.description: open: open the central file itself instead of a local copy (asks to confirm).

detach.description: open: detach from central. Default no.

worksets.description: open: worksets to open. Default last.

save.description: close: save first. Default false (unsaved changes ask to confirm).

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

preview.description: true = dry run: returns the plan and a confirm token, changes nothing.

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.

tools.name: worksharing
tools.title: Worksharing
tools.description: Workshared models: sync with central (comment, relinquish), reload latest, relinquish all, create/rename worksets, set active workset, move elements to a workset, borrow elements, enable worksharing.

op.description: sel = ids, from or filter. Params per op, optional after ';': sync(;comment,relinquish,compact) reload_latest() relinquish() workset_create(name) workset_rename(workset,name) set_active(workset) move_to(workset,sel) borrow(sel) enable(;name)

relinquish.description: sync: relinquish everything after. Default true.

name.description: New workset name (enable: name for the default workset).

from.description: Element set: r# handle from find_elements, 'selection', or 'last' (your last write).

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

preview.description: true = dry run: returns the plan and a confirm token, changes nothing.

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.

tools.name: links
tools.title: Links and imports
tools.description: Linked models and CAD: link RVT/IFC/DWG (origin, center or shared coordinates), import CAD, reload, reload from a new path, unload, remove, acquire coordinates. Read link contents via find_elements link=.

op.description: Params per op, optional after ';': link_rvt(path;position) link_ifc(path;position) link_cad(path;position,view,cad_units,this_view_only) import_cad(path;position,view,cad_units,this_view_only) reload(link) reload_from(link,path) unload(link) remove(link) acquire_coordinates(link)

view.description: CAD: view to place in. Default active.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

preview.description: true = dry run: returns the plan and a confirm token, changes nothing.

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.

tools.name: export
tools.title: Export files
tools.description: Export pdf (sheets/views, combined or not), dwg, dxf, ifc, nwc, image (hi-res), csv (schedules), fbx, gbxml to a folder (default <home>/exports/<doc>). Long exports continue as a job.

views.description: Views/sheets (names, numbers, ids), or ['all_sheets'], ['set:<sheet set>']. Default active view.

combine.description: pdf: one combined file. Default false.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.

tools.name: model_delivery
tools.title: Model delivery package
tools.description: Delivery packages of standalone RVTs (links, cleanup, exports, QA) from a saved recipe: inspect sources, preview (gives confirm), execute (job), save/get/list recipes, test fixture. Recipe shape: help topic=recipe.

op.description: Params per op, optional after ';': inspect(sources;project,recipe) preview(recipe) execute(confirm) save_recipe(recipe;expected_sha) get_recipe(project) list_recipes(;limit) fixture(template,folder,id)

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.

tools.name: change_set
tools.title: Atomic change set
tools.description: Run up to 100 write ops in one undo step, all or nothing; later ops use earlier results: '$0' (first id), '$0.ids', '$1.type'. ops=[{tool:'create_elements',op:'level',...}]. Not for open/save/sync/close.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

preview.description: true = dry run: returns the plan and a confirm token, changes nothing.

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.

units.description: Unit of input lengths. Default mm.

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undo your last write(s) in the target doc while they are still Revit's newest changes (steps 1-10, default 1); redo=true redoes. If the user edited since, explains how to revert instead.

mode.description: auto (default): Revit undo; compensate: apply the inverse change as a new write.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

tools.name: job_status
tools.title: Job status
tools.description: State, progress and result of a job (j#: export, sync, open, delivery, long scan) or of a write whose outcome was unclear (w#). wait= seconds to wait, 0-45, default 20. No id: your recent jobs.

id.description: Job id j# or write id w#.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for completion, 0-45. Default 20.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.title: Cancel job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running job or queued request. A running Revit step finishes or rolls back safely; partial exports and delivery staging are removed.

id.description: Job id j# or request id w#.

tools.name: help
tools.title: Help and examples
tools.description: Params and a working example for a tool or op: help {tool:'create_elements',op:'wall'}. topic= units, targeting, selectors, confirm, errors, recipe, run_csharp, workflow:<audit|sheets|family|rooms|visual>, error codes.

tools.name: run_csharp
tools.title: Run C# (opt-in)
tools.description: Run C# on the Revit API when no tool fits. Off unless the user enabled it locally. read and dry_run (default) always roll back; dry_run reports changes and a token; commit needs that token and the user's OK.

code.description: C# method body with doc, uidoc, app, args (IDictionary), log(object); return a value.

doc.description: Doc title, path or # from status. Default: pinned target.

confirm.description: Token from a NOT APPLIED or preview result; applies exactly that plan.
